detailed_description:
The target video uses a realistic live-action cinematic style with high-saturation lighting that highlights the glossy textures of the doll characters against the soft focus of the animated character.
[Shot 1] A wide medium shot establishes <Subject 4>, the elegant room with its white walls, pink curtains, and striped rug. In the center, <Subject 3> is suspended in mid-air, her arms stretched high and restrained to the ceiling by translucent bindings. Her body arches backward as she writhes. <Subject 1> stands on the left, leaning forward with a mischievous grin, while <Subject 2> stands on the right. Both dolls reach out with their plastic hands to vigorously tickle <Subject 3>'s ribs and armpits. <Subject 3> (S1) lets out a high-pitched, strained scream, <d>[English] I can't handle tickling please stop</d>. Her facial expression is one of exaggerated distress and laughter.
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, the camera pushes in to a close-up on the interaction. The focus sharpens on <Subject 3>'s torso as <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> rapidly move their fingers over her sides. <Subject 3>'s head bobs side to side, her hair flying with the motion of her thrashing body. She continues to vocalize her distress in a looped, frantic tone. The glossy skin of the dolls reflects the room's ambient light as they maintain their positions, creating a sharp visual contrast between the rigid plastic figures and the fluid, animated movement of <Subject 3>.

overall_soundscape:
A bright indoor room tone with the high-frequency squeaking of plastic doll joints rubbing against each other and the distinct rustling of fabric as <Subject 3> writhes in mid-air.

# Advanced reference - PDD Acc

## Purpose
Generate reference-guided video with a PDD Acc warm-up stage and two sampling stages.

## Use
1. Load reference media and write the scene prompt.
2. Review warm-up and main sampling settings, then set size and duration.
3. Run both stages and inspect the resulting video and audio.

Workflow: PDD-Acc-r2v-warmup-pod.json
